text:
sophie: quick UX discovery — in invite drawer for SSO-enforced orgs users get a disabled 'Assign roles' CTA and then DM support asking why. thinking of adding a tiny edu row under the CTA that explains and links to audit. figma: https://www.figma.com/file/abc/invite-edu?node-id=10%3A5
adrian: deep-link to audit is most useful. users want context, not just noise. keep CTA disabled visually and add a low-prominence link below it: 'View audit history for this role'.
mike: dev note: we'll deep-link to /audit?source=invite-drawer&event=invite.role&role=Admin — trivial to add. also can emit analytics event on click (invite_drawer.audit_click) with role param.
rachel: accessibility: disabled control should use `aria-disabled="true"` and be removed from tab order. the audit link must be keyboard-focusable. avoid turning a disabled control into an interactive element. tooltips must use `aria-describedby`, not `title`.
a11y-bot: automated scan of invite-drawer frame: flagged - disabled CTA present but lacks `aria-disabled`; microcopy contrast on proposed low-prominence row is borderline. recommend label color #cfd6df to reach 4.5:1 on our panel background. also recommend audit link include descriptive aria-label like "Open audit history filtered to role Admin".
sophie: copy drafts: tooltip (detailed): "Role assignments are managed by your identity provider. Contact your admin to change access." microcopy row: "SSO-managed roles — View audit history" link text: "View audit history for role Admin" short alt for tiny screens: "View audit history"
adrian: small product ask: include the `source=invite-drawer` param so we can tie funnel metrics to onboarding. also prefer not to open a modal for this — deep-link + small inline badge for first-time users is enough.
mike: inline badge non-interactive is low lift; inline panel would be heavier (i18n + focus trap). agree to postpone panel. will implement deep-link + badge + analytics next sprint if copy is final.
rachel: accessibility checklist for implementers: 1) disabled CTA: `aria-disabled="true"` and `tabindex="-1"` 2) add sibling link with `role="link"` and descriptive `aria-label` 3) tooltip pattern: `aria-describedby` with visible text in DOM 4) microcopy contrast >= 4.5:1 and tested in dark mode.
a11y-bot: auto-check after changes: ensure no reliance on `title`, ensure `aria-label` includes role, log analytics event name in codebook, and verify color contrast on mobile compact variant.
sophie: decision: 1) keep CTA disabled visually + `aria-disabled` 2) add micro-edu row with non-interactive 'SSO-managed' badge and a visible link 'View audit history for role <role>' that deep-links 3) emit `invite_drawer.audit_click` analytics with role and source params 4) postpone modal/slide-over to later cycle. timeline: final copy by Thu EOD, devs pick up next sprint.
adrian: will draft the copy variants and add the analytics spec.
mike: assigned; will add unit tests for query params and aria attributes.
a11y-bot: final: checklist saved to ticket #INT-3241. recommend running automated contrast + keyboard nav tests after implementation.
